blocks.text: GPT-6.2 Astra 是我们首个对外发布、达到“AI 自我改进”高阈值的模型，该阈值衡量的是模型加速 AI 研究的能力。评为“高”，意味着我们评估该模型的影响相当于在 2024 年基线之上，为每位 OpenAI 研究员额外配备一名能力很强的研究工程师作为助手。我们追踪这一能力，是因为能帮助开发未来 AI 系统的模型也可能带来新的安全风险，比如让进展速度超过安全保障或人类监督所能适应的程度。

blocks.text: AI research capabilities and safeguards

inlines.text: AI research capabilities and safeguards

blocks.text: GPT-6.2 Astra is our first externally released model to meet the High threshold for AI Self-improvement, which measures a model’s ability to accelerate AI research. A ‘High’ designation reflects our assessment that the model’s impact is equivalent to giving every OpenAI researcher an additional, highly capable research engineer as an assistant, relative to their 2024 baseline. We track this capability because models that can help develop future AI systems could also introduce new risks to safety, like accelerating progress faster than safeguards or human oversight can adapt.

blocks.text: To address these risks, we’ve built more oversight and controls into how we train and deploy our models. Before expanding internal access to GPT-6.2 Astra, we evaluated its alignment and verified that required safeguards were in place at each stage. We strengthened containment in our research environments⁠, and tested those protections with our most capable models. We also built Control Room⁠, a system that tracks research workloads and can halt further model output when intervention is needed. Our expanded monitoring⁠ examines models’ reasoning and actions across internal workloads and supported external deployments. It can automatically flag unauthorized behavior, and, where supported, pause workloads or conversations.
